text: Wuhan Control Speedbird 782. We have a fast moving traffic in front of us. It looks like a fighter from here. We don't have it on our TCAS. Have you observed it? We didn't see it on our radar either. Probably a fighter without a transponder or not using a transponder. Question. What are they talking about?
